scope.graph_discovery: No native graph tools were exposed. Scoped reads of source, consumers, contract and official dependency documentation were used.
scope.fixture_confinement: Only script copies in temporary workspaces were executed. Fixture PATH contains owned Python substitutes for Git/Gitleaks/gate/uv and a narrow shell-utility whitelist. HOME/TMPDIR are temporary; no protected runtime or operator stores are used. Binding tests substitute pwd/getuid with synthetic values.
scope.positive_test_scope: Positive tests exercise pure effect/signature math and the actual extracted dispatch helper against fake Git. They do not satisfy the production ATTESTED status gate and do not prove hardware authorization.

findings.basis: The scanner is mandatory before preparation. The immutable clean tree is materialized from raw objects with replacement refs disabled; export-ignore/worktree contents cannot omit or substitute the input. Regular tracked policy and ignores are read inside that snapshot; missing scanner, nonzero scan or uninspectable tree prevents gate/dispatch. This establishes the scan path and rejection behavior, not universal secret-detection efficacy.

Gate/runtime absence rejects before ship mutations. A selected gate is invoked once, with bounded time/output and process-group termination; failed/cancelled/empty/malformed/non-attested outcomes reject without push or fallback. The current effect hash, metadata, session operator and P-256 signature are checked before the production dispatcher call.

The dispatch refspec uses the immutable commit captured in a readonly envelope. Commit/tree/destination/ref/force/action/scope/agent/config digest/new nonce are bound into domain-separated SHA256. Git publication uses a private bare repository with frozen transport configuration and explicit URL, excluding mutable remote aliases and URL rewrite configuration. Scheduled second invocation, overlapping attempts, and benign fake-Git dispatch controls preserve the first commit selection.

resolved_review_findings.topic: Archive filtering versus full published tree
resolved_review_findings.initial_basis: Design used git archive, whose export-ignore handling can omit published blobs.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Raw ls-tree/cat-file snapshot, including raw symlink blobs; scanner operates inside snapshot with contained policy/ignore inputs.
resolved_review_findings.validation: Raw export-ignored fixture content reaches scanner; independent symlink fixture remains a regular raw blob.

resolved_review_findings.initial_basis: An explicit URL alone can still be rewritten by Git configuration; default remote get-url uses fetch URL.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Resolve exactly one expanded --push --all URL, freeze permitted transport configuration, bind its digest, and dispatch from an isolated bare repo without ambient Git config.
resolved_review_findings.validation: Fake-Git dispatcher ignores changed branch and inherited URL-rewrite environment while selecting exact commit/ref/URL.

resolved_review_findings.initial_basis: Git object readers normally honor refs/replace while pack transfer does not.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Export GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS and force it in helper reads; streaming object inspection explicitly uses --no-replace-objects.
resolved_review_findings.validation: Regression inspects object-read environment; source checks cover all content/commit reads.

resolved_review_findings.topic: Skipping hooks and LFS payload upload
resolved_review_findings.initial_basis: An isolated bare push would skip source pre-push hooks, including the installed Git LFS hook.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Reject active executable pre-push hooks and LFS pointer content before gate. Reject gitlinks. Recognize all three supported LFS version headers including whitespace/CRLF.
resolved_review_findings.validation: Both scripts reject hook/LFS fixtures before gate/dispatch; version/header variants are tested. This is rejection, not support for these repositories.

resolved_review_findings.initial_basis: GIT_SSH is a program path, whereas core.sshCommand is shell text; JSON ASCII escaping also misrepresented Unicode alternate paths.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Quote GIT_SSH with shlex.quote; write UTF-8 alternate paths with ensure_ascii=False.
resolved_review_findings.validation: Source review against Git program-path and C-style path contracts; no real SSH or Git execution.

resolved_review_findings.initial_basis: Conditional killpg only while leader was alive could leave a descendant holding stdout after deadline.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: On failure/deadline attempt process-group kill regardless of leader liveness; tolerate absent groups.
resolved_review_findings.validation: Independent fixture wrapper exits first; descendant fails to write its scheduled marker after the timeout.

resolved_review_findings.topic: Archive size estimated with fixed overhead
resolved_review_findings.initial_basis: Raw size plus fixed per-file overhead was not a universal tar size bound.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Serialize the actual normalized PAX snapshot through a counting sink and reject at 20 MiB.
resolved_review_findings.validation: A raw payload below threshold whose tar padding crosses threshold is rejected before scanner.

checks.result: Removing only the added tar-padding payload branch, new test and trailing blank lines reconstructs SHA256 f3042b67d6d6e9a136995183ecc6c26c0caaa962ca83399b5b4feee5732f870c. Existing 66 cases are unchanged.

intermediate_results.result: 28 passed, 1 failed during an intermediate source/fixture update
intermediate_results.scope: The newly added --no-replace-objects inspection was not yet recognized by the fake-Git stub. Reported immediately; superseded by the final passing run. No production Git was executed.

source_checks.observation: Replacement refs disabled at shell entry and each helper Git read.
Exact effect metadata, normalized agent allowlist, current-session user, finite fresh timestamp and P-256 signature over ASCII SHA256 digest. LFS legacy/CRLF headers rejected.
Raw blob materialization validates paths/types/policy, preserves full scan input, never follows symlinks, and counts actual serialized PAX size.
Reject active pre-push hooks/LFS/gitlinks, select one push URL, freeze transport inputs, bind commit/tree/ref/force/config and per-attempt nonce.
Single selected gate invocation; selector caps 64 KiB and deadline; group killed on failure; strict JSON status/binding/signature precede receipt creation.
Private Git repo, frozen config, exact immutable refspec and destination, remote observation after push; mismatch fails without retry.
Mandatory scanner, private temporary index/snapshot, snapshot-only scan, readonly tree/commit/envelope, gate then dispatcher. Preview explicitly leaves authorization/push NOT_CHECKED.
Mandatory gate/runtime preflight precedes alias and later commit/merge/fetch operations; status path returns earlier without mutation.
Capture immutable HEAD/tree, prepare frozen envelope, require gate completion, then dispatch. No persistent last_ship_receipt path remains.
Dependency contract requires 32-byte causal hash and signs ASCII hash bytes when sign-hex is absent.
Gate prefixes agent with detected caller environment; reviewed validator matches known normalized variants.
Gate produces DER P-256 signature and X9.63 public point with session fields; read only, never invoked.

limitations: No real Git commands, secret scanner, remote publication, Swift execution, biometric authentication or Secure Enclave operation were run. No ATTESTED fixture/object was fabricated. Successful protected end-to-end authorization remains unverified.

The selected local gate is a trusted dependency. Verifying a signature against the public key supplied in its own receipt proves self-consistency, not independent hardware-key provenance or independent identity of the root operator.

Active pre-push hooks, LFS pointers and gitlinks are unsupported and explicitly rejected before authorization. This repository has an installed Git LFS pre-push hook, so this dispatcher refuses that configuration; removing or bypassing it is not authorized or recommended by this review.

Receipt retention changed: receipt.json exists only in the private per-invocation temporary directory and is deleted by the EXIT cleanup. .babylon60/last_ship_receipt.json is no longer written. No reader was found in the scoped callers; this review does not certify persistent audit retention.

Git URL/transport configuration is frozen for dispatch. Executables, credential helpers, external SSH/TLS/proxy configuration and local filesystem integrity remain trusted dependencies; the code is not an OS sandbox against a malicious same-user process.
The scanner applies the tracked policy and ignores in the snapshot. Its policy exclusions and detection coverage are not equivalent to a guarantee that every possible secret is detected.

The existing ship staging/commit/merge/fetch/status workflow is outside the corrected publication findings and was not executed against a real repository. C0414 is not reopened; SW100-R3-0001 remains separate from the original 598 IDs.

A failed post-push ref observation may occur after the remote effect; the script reports failure without retry. These fixtures do not establish rollback, network availability or remote-server behavior.
